from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiability(BaseModel):
    """Total liabilities reported in one company's financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    liability_total: float | None = Field(description="The total liabilities amount in yuan (元)")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date of the financial report")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of financial report (e.g., 2024年第一季度财务报告)")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Source text or excerpt containing the liability figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liabilities: list[CompanyLiability]
